content:
**Starlight Berry Cobbler** is a consumable in *Fallout 76*.

A thick-crusted, pie-like cobbler made with Starlight Berries. It increases Endurance by 1, moderately heals HP, satisfies some hunger, and gives a low dose of Radiation when consumed.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Starlight Berries | | Starlight Berry Cobbler (1) | 

Can be crafted at a Cooking Station with the correct ingredients after having picked Starlight Berries for the first time.

- The endurance boost will not stack with any other endurance boosting food. It will, however, stack with endurance boosting drinks and chems.
- Yasmin Chowdhury mentions creating a variant of the cobbler, describing it as a "deconstructed Starlight Berry Cobbler", which they've reconstructed. [1] 

1. ↑ Yasmin Chowdhury: *"Who said dessert can't be a meal? This is a deconstructed Starlight Berry Cobbler that I've had to... err, reconstruct."*
(Yasmin Chowdhury's dialogue)
